statement: The slow marginal is a positive Laplace transform with source coordinates |t_j|<=sqrt(beta)||A_column||1<=sqrt(beta n Lambda). Positive N-node Gauss–Hermite obeys exp(t^2/2)Pr(Pois(t^2/2)<N)<=Q_N exp(tG)<=exp(t^2/2);tensor/positive-measure integration preserves the bound. This yields a source-audited FPRAS at FIXED physical/spectral promises,not f(r)poly(n) or arbitrary low-temperature efficiency.
